main.description: Revoke one kubeconfig of the named cluster of the calling account: sets spec.revoked on its ClusterClientCertificate record. The client certificate front admits a certificate only while its record exists and is not revoked, so the kubeconfig stops working within the front's watch latency. Idempotent. deleteCluster, revokeIdentity and signing out of the web app revoke every kubeconfig of a cluster the same way.
